description: Baseline (valid): warm MCP steady-state metric, harness compact fix

asi.hypothesis: Warm per-call recall latency is dominated by fixed per-call overhead: a fresh libsql connection per storage call (~10/query), repeated PRAGMA table_info probes, per-query settings reads, and a graph-traversal UPDATE that full-scans memory_links through an OR join.
asi.note: BENCH_PROFILE at 300 memories: graph_traverse_bounded 292ms, keyword_search 52ms, record_retrieval_trace 25ms, count_memories 1.2ms => ~1ms per libsql round trip. Manual warm probe: p50 265ms at 177 memories.

description: Share one libsql connection handle across storage calls (get_conn clones an Arc instead of re-opening the DB file per call)

asi.hypothesis: libsql Database::connect() re-opens the sqlite file for the local backend; ~10 calls per recall query each paid an open. Connection is Arc<dyn Conn> + derive(Clone), so one handle cloned per call removes ~10 file opens per query with zero SQL changes.
asi.expected: warm p95 418ms -> well under 300ms; cold cli/mcp p95 also drop since each process makes many calls
